AvgResolveLatency.description_en: The average resolution latency across all VPCs that have network traffic analysis enabled. The average resolution latency is the average time elapsed from when the Alibaba Cloud DNS server receives a DNS query request to when it generates and returns a resolution response
AvgResolveLatency.description_zh: 统计所有启用流量分析的VPC的平均解析时延。平均解析时延是指：阿里云 DNS 服务器从接收到 DNS 查询请求起，到生成并返回解析应答为止的平均耗时

AvgResolveLatencyTrend.description_en: The trend of the average resolution latency across all VPCs that have network traffic analysis enabled
AvgResolveLatencyTrend.description_zh: 统计所有启用流量分析的VPC的平均解析时延趋势变化

AvgSuccessRatio.description_en: The average resolution success rate across all VPCs that have network traffic analysis enabled
AvgSuccessRatio.description_zh: 统计所有启用流量分析的VPC的平均解析成功率

AvgSuccessRatioTrend.description_en: The trend of the average resolution success rate across all VPCs that have network traffic analysis enabled
AvgSuccessRatioTrend.description_zh: 统计所有启用流量分析的VPC的平均解析成功率趋势变化

TotalResolveCount.description_en: The total number of DNS resolutions across all VPCs that have network traffic analysis enabled
TotalResolveCount.description_zh: 统计所有启用流量分析VPC的总解析数

TotalResolveCountTrend.description_en: The trend of DNS resolution volume across all VPCs that have network traffic analysis enabled
